name: Wizard Alchemy Saint
body:
Few are as adroit as the velar at combining alchemy, science, and magic to enrich their knowledge and achieve the impossible.

Requirement: An alchemy saint must be a velar.

Diminished Spellcasting: An alchemy saint casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, they may only cast spells of that level if their Intelligence score provides bonus extracts or spells of that level. This ability alters spells.

Brew Potion

An alchemy saint gains Brew Potion as a bonus feat; they do not need to meet the prerequisites for this feat. This ability replaces scribe scroll.

Scientific Scholar

At 1st level, an alchemy saint’s early years of blending velar science and magic has taught them how to use the technology of other civilizations. An alchemy saint gains the Technologist feat as a bonus feat.

Practical Alchemy

Starting at 2nd level, an alchemy saint gains a breakthrough in their pursuit of alchemy. An alchemy saint gains a bonus feat of their choice at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level. The chosen bonus feat must have either the Brew Potion feat or the Craft (alchemy) skill as part of its prerequisites. The alchemy saint must still meet the prerequisites of the chosen bonus feat. This ability replaces arcane school.

Potion Glutton

At 3rd level, an alchemy saint gains Potion Glutton as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites.

Pharmaceutical Genius

At 7th level, the knowledge tree of an alchemy saint’s non-magical alchemy has branched off into a broad range of medicinal products. An alchemy saint gains Craft Pharmaceutical as a bonus feat; they do not need to meet the prerequisites for this feat.

Advanced Alchemy

Starting at 10th level, an alchemy saint’s alchemy breaks free of traditional limits. The alchemy saint can create magic potions and oils of 4th-, 5th-, 6th-, 7th-, 8th-, and 9th-level spells at 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, 18th, and 20th levels respectively. Creating magic potions or oils of 4th-level or higher extracts or spells must still abide by the rules of the Brew Potion feat. This ability functions as the Brew Powerful Potion feat for the purposes of meeting prerequisites but it does not stack with the Brew Powerful Potion feat.
